principles.title: Direct from distilleries
principles.text: Casks are selected directly from distilleries, even though this deliberately limits the available choice and makes negotiations more demanding.

principles.title: Ready for bottling
principles.text: Since 2022, CMWS has focused on mature whisky intended for immediate bottling rather than speculative long-term cask ownership with unclear outcome.

principles.title: Quality before quantity
principles.text: CMWS does not acquire every cask offered. A selection is made only when the whisky meets the group's expectations. If you want a typical distillery bottling, go and buy core range. We are looking for unusual expressions!
